summary: Ituran Location & Control Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K announcing an update to the withholding tax procedures for its previously declared dividend of $0.50 per ordinary share, or roughly $10 million total, payable October 14, 2026 to holders of record September 29, 2026, initially announced August 12, 2026. The company obtained a tax ruling from the Israeli Tax Authority allowing certain shareholders a reduced withholding rate versus the general 25% rate for non-substantial holders and 30% for 10%-plus shareholders. IBI Trust Management serves as coordinating agent. Watch the payout mechanics and any shareholder tax-reduction eligibility disputes.
